name: huginn-voice
description: Dictate into the Claude Code prompt box. Speech is transcribed by your own Huginn server (faster-whisper on its GPU), not by a cloud service.

api_key.title: Huginn API key
api_key.description: A named Huginn user key. Empty: the HUGINN_API_KEY environment variable is used.

url.title: Huginn URL
url.description: The Huginn server that hosts the ear.

mic.title: Microphone (pulse source)
mic.description: PulseAudio source name. Under WSL2 (WSLg) the Windows microphone is RDPSource. List sources with: ffmpeg -sources pulse

python.title: Python executable
python.description: The interpreter that runs bin/huginn-ear.py (stdlib only).
